record.context_brief: Restricted sumset formula when m <= p
record.original_question: Let G be a finite abelian group of order n, let p be the smallest prime divisor of n, and assume h < m <= p. Is the minimum size of the h-fold restricted sumset of an m-element subset always min{p, hm - h^2 + 1}? In other words, does rho_hat(G, m, h) = min{p, hm - h^2 + 1} hold throughout this range?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6 If p is the smallest prime divisor of n and h < m <= p, then rho_hat(G, m, h) = min{p, hm - h^2 + 1}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite abelian group of order $n$, and let $p$ denote the smallest prime divisor of $n$. For a subset $A \subseteq G$ and a positive integer $h$, define the $h$-fold restricted sumset of $A$ by
$$h^{\wedge} A \;=\; \{\, a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_h : a_1, \dots, a_h \in A \text{ are pairwise distinct} \,\}.$$
For positive integers $m$ and $h$ with $h \le m \le |G|$, define
$$\hat{\rho}(G, m, h) \;=\; \min\bigl\{\, |h^{\wedge} A| : A \subseteq G,\ |A| = m \,\bigr\}.$$
Assume $h < m \le p$. Determine whether
$$\hat{\rho}(G, m, h) \;=\; \min\bigl\{\, p,\ hm - h^2 + 1 \,\bigr\}$$
holds for every such finite abelian group $G$ and every pair $(m, h)$ in this range.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface related work by Bajnok and others on minimum sizes of restricted sumsets in finite abelian groups, including exact values in special cases (cyclic groups, h=2 by Dias da Silva–Hamidoune, etc.) and explicit upper bounds, but no source explicitly confirms or refutes the precise conjecture that $\hat{\rho}(G,m,h)=\min\{p, hm-h^2+1\}$ for all finite abelian groups $G$ when $h<m\le p$. Status could not be conclusively verified from the available sources.

status_evidence.title: On the minimum size of restricted sumsets in cyclic groups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies rho_hat for cyclic groups and related conjectures on minimum restricted sumset sizes.
status_evidence.claim: Related but specific conjecture for general finite abelian groups not verified as solved.

status_evidence.title: Critical Numbers for Restricted Sumsets: Rigidity and Collapse in Finite Abelian Groups
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work classifying critical numbers for restricted sumsets in finite abelian groups.
status_evidence.claim: Recent investigations continue, but the specific conjectured formula in the range h<m<=p is not stated as fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: A Walk Through Some Newer Parts of Additive Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing open problems on restricted sumsets including small-set regimes.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys list this regime among ongoing problems, suggesting the conjecture is not universally established.
